g.text: Redis under UB's protocol: KJIT on is slower than off at every value size

g.text: Throughput falls to 0.28-0.75 of native and server CPU per request rises 1.4-3.6x; UB's published GET gain is not reached and the transition-removal ceiling is only +6..18%.
